rationale: Constant key 'seq_parallel_comm_data_type' mismatches documented 'seq_parallel_communication_data_type', so user value is silently dropped at parse and dtype defaults to fp32. Detection compares user-set key vs parsed engine config at init. Borderline dtype vs control_flow: chose control_flow because the root cause is config-key wiring at init, not a numeric dtype computation. parallel_dim=none (single-rank parses config). P1 trace equality on parsed config field.
